text: I love it! I loved the experience and the fact that you can choose the products, routine and the fact thats educational as well. I would recommend!🥰 check ther instagram aswell

developer_reply: Thank you for reviewing the app, glad you appreciate the educational part of it! :) ROUTINES UPDATE: now there's a possibility to create multiple routines (exercise, haircare..), edit steps for a specific day, mark steps as "Done", set routine reminders! :) Hope you enjoy the update!
